label: sub_043_picnicnpc_system_01
text: You got [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]a variety of ingredients[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_system_02
text: You put the ingredients in your Bag’s [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Picnic Items[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\npocket.

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_01_01
text: I just went shopping for sandwich ingredients and\nbought more than I could use. Mind taking some?

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_01_02
text: There you go. Try making some nice, tasty\nsandwiches! A picnic’s not a picnic without ’em!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_01_06
text: Since you’re here, want to kick back with your\nPokémon at my picnic for a bit?

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_01_03
text: Hey, welcome to my picnic. Want to kick back\nwith your Pokémon for a bit?

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_01_04
text: Looks like you and your Pokémon got a good\nrest! Come on by and kick back anytime.

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_01_05
text: All right. But if you get worn out, don’t push it.\nJust come on by and kick back anytime.

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_02_01
text: My poor Bag’s full to bursting with ingredients!\nHere, lemme share some with you.

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_02_02
text: Sandwiches are best when you eat ’em outside!\nTry making some with the stuff I gave you!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_02_06
text: Hey, since we’re here, want to have a picnic so\nyou can rest up a little?

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_02_03
text: Want to rest up a bit at my picnic?

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_02_04
text: You and your Pokémon look like you’re all full\nof energy! Come again anytime.

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_02_05
text: Aw, no need to be shy about it! You can come by\nanytime.

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_03_01
text:
This spot is just about halfway between
Mesagoza and Artazon!\c
I’m gonna make me a nice sandwich, then I’ll be
all refueled and ready for more adventuring!\c
Here—have some ingredients so you can get
refueled too!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_03_02
text: Totally unrelated, but I heard there’s a cliff face\nnear here that...moves. Wonder if it’s true...

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_03_06
text: You should take a breather here and get ready so\nyou don’t get too surprised by any moving walls!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_03_03
text: Are you running a little low on energy? Take a\nminute to rest and refuel!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_03_04
text: Both people AND Pokémon need to refuel\nsometimes. Come back if you’re low on energy!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_03_05
text: If you say so! Just remember not to push yourself\ntoo hard!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_04_01
text:
Whew, these hills are rougher than I thought
they’d be. I’m beat.\c
Times like these call for a nice meal to refresh
the body and soul!\c
Here, take some of my ingredients to refresh
yourself with!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_04_02
text: Tackling tough challenges is great and all, but not\non an empty tummy!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_04_06
text: We all need company and compassion, especially\non the road! Want to stop and refresh yourself?

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_04_03
text: Hills got you down? Need a little pick-me-up?

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_04_04
text: It’s nice to have a refreshing meal! We gotta help\neach other out in tough times. Stop by anytime!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_04_05
text: Amazing what young folks like you can do! Wish I\nstill had that pep in my step!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_05_01
text:
Nothing goes with a sandwich like a nice view!
Haha!\c
Glad to have run into you, kiddo. Here’s a gift—
make sure to savor the taste of adventure!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_05_02
text: Eating a sandwich and getting pumped with Meal\nPowers makes journeying all the better! Haha!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_05_06
text: Care to rest those traveling feet and stop for a\nwhile, since you’re here?

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_05_03
text: Everyone needs a break now and then! Care to\nrest those traveling feet and enjoy the scenery?

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_05_04
text: Working hard is key, but so is getting off your\nfeet now and then! Besides, you can’t enjoy the\r\nscenery when you’re always on the move! Haha!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_05_05
text: Fair enough—nothing wrong with living fast!\nCome by if you ever need a little rest.

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_06_01
text:
I bought some ingredients on the cheap at the
Porto Marinada market!\c
But I got more than I could eat, so...voilà! Have
some for yourself!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_06_02
text: If you have a picnic with your friends and all\nbring lots of ingredients, you can whip up some\r\npretty wild sandwiches! It’s fun!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_06_06
text: For now, though, you ought to take a breather—\nit’s rough going around these parts!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_06_03
text: Going north or south from here is rough. You\nought to take a breather before you move on!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_06_04
text: There you go—seems like you got a nice rest!\nGood luck on your adventure!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_06_05
text: Ah, maybe you’re just headed west to Porto\nMarinada? I’ll mind my own business!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_07_01
text:
I saw some strange Pokémon around Casseroya
Lake, and they gave me a flash of inspiration!\c
I came up with some great recipes—please use
them to make yourself some tasty sandwiches!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_addrecipe_01
text: You learned how to make [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Sushi Sandwiches[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_07_02
text:
Now, I know sushi’s normally a rice dish. No
bread’s involved.\c
But I figured...why not put sushi in a sandwich?
Then you’ve got bread AND rice—twice as tasty!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_07_06
text: Seeing as how we’ve run into each other at this\nnice lake, want to join me for a little break?

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_07_03
text: Ahhh, a lakeside picnic! Nothing better! Care to\nrest up?

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_07_04
text: I wonder what makes lakes so relaxing... Well,\nwhatever it is, it looks like you had a nice rest!

label: sub_043_picnicnpc_07_05
text: Got it. Come by if you’re ever craving a taste of\nthe lakeside life!
